What can you send at a
Royal Mail Postbox?

There are two main types of Postboxes that can be used to drop off your parcels:

Regular Postboxes
These postboxes are for letters and small parcels.

Parcel Postboxes
If your parcel is too big, use a Parcel Postbox.
